Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Name of Work: Implementation of Centralized Windows Security & Anti-Virus Patch Manageme nt in OT Systems installed across IOCL Refineries and Petrochemical plants by M/s Honeywell o n proprietary basis and subscription services for one year. 1. Payment Terms IOCL shall pay the bidder for the material and services provided as per the scope of work and price schedul e. No payment will be made for sub-standard work not meeting the requirement unless defects are rectified to the satisfaction of IOCL site representatives. Invoice (s) with supporting documents will be submitted after completion of each stage by the bidder and p ayment shall be made within 30 days from the date of receipt of undisputed invoice and related documents certified by Site EICs and RHQ EIC. Payment will be made in two parts as under: A. Material and I&C (Capital Part) a. 80% after submission of design documents and supply of materials at all locations. b. 10% after satisfactory installation & commissioning at all sites.

c. 10% after completion of site acceptance test (SAT*). *SAT completion means automated end-to-end deployment of qualified security patches on qualified EPKS/ OS release R520, and above nodes installed across Refineries. For non-compliant OT nodes (Not on the qua lified EPKS/OS), if any, bidder responsibility shall be limited to the supply of license and provision of patch u pdate facility up to service node at site. It shall be the bidder’s responsibility during deployment phase to cl early identify and submit the list of non-compliant OT nodes to IOCL before SAT. IOCL shall be responsible f or bringing non-compliant systems up to the qualified EPKS/OS release for automated deployment of securi ty and AV patches. B. Subscription Charges (Revenue Part) • Payment against subscription charges shall be released on quarterly basis against submission of invoice along with detailed patching report showing success/failure rates, List of nodes with pending patches/errors and Trend analysis & root cause analysis and a resolution plan. •Subscription shall start after completion of SAT. 2. Job Completion Schedule 6 months from award of job as per following schedule. Months from PO award M-1 M-2 M-3 M-4 M-5 M-6 Delivery of Material Installation & Commissioning and solution implementa tion 3. Warranty: Bidder shall offer comprehensive warranty of 36 months from the da te of supply or 24 months from the date of commissioning on supplie d hardware, whichever is earlier. 4. Performance bank guarantee (PBG): Not applicable 5. Liquidity Damage: As per GeM GTC 6. Integrity pact: Applicable 7. NDA (non-disclosure agreement): Applicable 8. Bid Security Deposit (BSD): M/s HAIL need to submit BSD as per format Format Annexure – 1 av ailable with tender documents. 9. Techno commercial Deviations (if any) shall be indicated in the deviation form at only. Deviations indicated elsewhere shall be treated as nil. 10. Defect liability period: 01 Year

11. Inspection: Inspection shall be carried out by IOCL after receiving material at r espective sites. Bidder’s Scope of Work Bidder shall deliver the following for successful implementation of centralized windows security & anti-virus patch management in OT systems installed across IOCL Refineries along with subscription services for one year. 1. Implementation Services for Repository Server and Network at RHQ o Kick-off meeting to validate project expectations and deliverables. o Prepare and submit a comprehensive IP addressing and network segregation scheme for all OT systems a cross refineries, with provision for future expansion and avoiding IP conflicts. o Software installation and configuration of IOCL-provided Repository Server and associated Firewalls for se cure connectivity with Honeywell Cyber Security Center (HCSC). o Firewall configuration and establishing secure connections between Repository Server at RHQ and Relay S ervers at individual Refineries. Backbone network connectivity between RHQ and sites shall be in IOCL sco pe. o Required software installation and configuration in Repository Server at RHQ to deliver the contracted pat ching services. o Configuration and import of customer device list. 2. Implementation Services for Relay & Service Nodes and Associated Network Devices at Refineries • Install and configure all required software on relay & service node servers at Refineries. • Undertake necessary configuration changes in firewalls and other network devices to ensure seamless int egration. • Provide timely updates to validated anti-virus signature files on supported releases to ensure the latest pr otection on each applicable OT node. • Assist with patch deployment and ensure safe installation of updates/patches on all individual nodes. • Provide a systematic and risk-averse approach for accessing and deployment of validated windows securi ty and anti-virus patches on applicable OT nodes. 3. Patch deployment: The validated patches will be made available to the relay nodes (L3.5, DMZ) and shall be deployed through service nodes (L3) to individual OT Windows nodes under bidder’s supervision. Where end nodes are incompatible with the qualified patches, the bidder shall deploy the patches up to the service node at each site. Assistance required in configuration of the repository server, including creating d eployment groups and identifying group devices/members, shall be in the bidder’s scope. 4. Patch Deployment Cycle: Qualified patches shall be deployed and reported as successful across 95% of a ll target OT nodes within one week of the patch release by Honeywell's Cyber Security Center. 5. Patch Failure Remediation: For any patch deployment failure on any OT node, the bidder shall provide ro ot cause analysis and a resolution plan within 48 hours and resolve the failure within 7 days. 6. Detailed Patching Reports/ Compliance Dashboards: The bidder shall mandatorily develop, implement and maintain comprehensive OT Patching Compliance Da shboards at both RHQ and respective Units for centralized monitoring and assessment of OT patching activi ties. The dashboards shall, at a minimum, provide site-wise visibility of the following: a) OT patch deployment status, including successful and failed patch installations.

b) List of OT nodes/systems with pending patches, failed patches, errors or exceptions, along with the reason/status of resolution. c) Patch compliance status against the defined patching schedule/baseline. d) Site-wise and system-wise compliance statistics and trend analysis of patching performance. e) Details of outstanding patches and their ageing/status. f) Appropriate metrics and KPIs for monitoring the overall effectiveness and compliance of OT patch manag ement. The bidder shall submit detailed patching reports and relevant compliance metrics along with each quarterl y invoice for subscription charges. The quarterly reports shall be generated from the compliance dashboard s and shall provide adequate evidence of the patching activities and compliance status during the billing pe riod. The dashboards and reports shall be accessible to authorized personnel at RHQ and Units and shall be mai ntained/updated by the bidder throughout the subscription period. 7. Virus Protection Management • The Bidder shall coordinate to protect the PCN (Process Control Network) systems by maintaining up-to-d ate Anti-Virus definitions via an automated yet controlled process. The update system will reside on the Ser vice Node within the PCN. • Virus Protection Definition: Conduct a daily search for newly published definition updates; test new signat ure files to avoid impact on PCN. • Virus Protection Deployment: Updates will be pulled by the Relay Node and made available for installation through the Service Node; verify proper configuration of the ePO distribution application. • Prerequisite: Anti-Virus software including ePO distribution agent and associated configuration shall be pr ovided by the Bidder. 9. Services Bidder to assist/provide necessary information for configuration of one DMZ Next Generation Firewall with I PS Protection at Level 3.5. The Firewalls configuration will include the following (as applicable): a) Hostname, DNS and Management services configuration b) Creating interfaces and Security Zones; assigning interfaces to the zones c) Static routes and gateways d) NTP, SNMP, SSH and Logging configuration e) VPN configuration (if required) f) Creating access policies between the zones (IOCL to provide access control lists and port numbers; Hone ywell to configure them on Firewalls) g) All other configuration, tools and tackles required for successful commissioning 10. Documentation: Detailed Design Document (DDD) to the satisfaction of the EIC shall be provided by Bidder. 11. Subscription and Support Coverage: Bidder shall consider one year (1st year) subscription services for OT patch management after SAT as part of the scope of work and shall mandatorily quote the same in BoQ. To ensure continuity beyond the initial i mplementation phase (1st year), bidder to ensure provision of extended subscription beyond 1st year. 12. Training: Bidder to mandatorily conduct structured training not less than one day at each site on the us age, maintenance, reporting, and troubleshooting of the Central Patch Management System, with all system

documentation delivered in a format suitable for long-term internal use. 13. For non-compliant OT nodes (Not on the qua lified EPKS/OS), if any, bidder responsibility shall be limited to the supply of license and provision of patch u pdate facility up to service node at site. It shall be the bidder’s responsibility during deployment phase to cl early identify and submit the list of non-compliant OT nodes to IOCL before SAT.
